successCriteria.description: A new test case exists inside the existing `describe('addMonths', ...)` block of tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts that asserts `addMonths(new Date(Date.UTC(2023, 0, 31)), 3)` equals `Date.UTC(2023, 3, 30)` (Jan 31 + 3 months = Apr 30).

The same (or an additional) test case asserts `addMonths(new Date(Date.UTC(2023, 2, 31)), 1)` equals `Date.UTC(2023, 3, 30)` (Mar 31 + 1 month = Apr 30), covering clamping from a 31-day month to a 30-day target month.
The new test(s) use `Date.UTC(...)` for date construction and `.getTime()` for comparison, matching the existing assertion style in the `addMonths` describe block.
The full Jest suite passes (`npx jest`) with the new test included, and no existing test is modified or removed.

constraints: The new test must be added inside the existing `describe('addMonths', ...)` block in tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts; do not create a new describe block or a new test file.
Do not modify `src/shared/date/accrual.ts` (or any production source) — this phase is test-only; the implementation already clamps correctly.
Use `Date.UTC(...)` to construct dates and compare via `.getTime()`, consistent with the surrounding tests; do not introduce local-time date construction.
outOfScope: Changing or refactoring the `addMonths` implementation in src/shared/date/accrual.ts.
Adding coverage for other date helpers (startOfUtcDay, periodContaining) or other clamp scenarios beyond 31→30-day months.
Introducing new test utilities, fixtures, or assertion helpers beyond the existing Jest/Date.UTC style.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The new test must assert the exact behavior of `addMonths` as defined in src/shared/date/accrual.ts: it clamps the original day to the last day of the target month via `Math.min(day, lastDay)`, so Jan 31 + 3 → Apr 30 and Mar 31 + 1 → Apr 30.
The new test must match the existing assertion style (Date.UTC construction + .getTime() comparison) and live inside the existing `describe('addMonths', ...)` block.
